run_evaluate_softmax: run the evaluation script to compute Top-1 accuracy on ImageNet validation set softmax predictions
run_with_architecture: run the script with a specific architecture like ResNet50 or PNASNet to evaluate its softmax output
run_with_version: run the evaluation with version v1 or v2 to load the correct softmax numpy file format
run_with_custom_path: run the script with a custom save path to evaluate softmax files from a different directory
run_default_evaluation: run the default evaluation using IGAM_Resnext101_32x48d architecture with v1 softmax files
